findings.summary: The RC1 endpoint allowlist admits /api/v3/system/status, a ProbeAsync-only path the reads under test never call, so a provider request to it would not fail the negative test; it is however not a library revision token per ADR-018 research, so the stated TQ-11.3-1 purpose is met.
findings.detail: RC1 added AllowedProviderEndpointPaths (six paths, including /api/v3/system/status) and AllowedProviderQueryKeys to ProviderReadsUseNoConditionalRequestRevisionTokenOrHistorySinceWatermark, and the test now asserts Assert.Contains(request.Uri.AbsolutePath, AllowedProviderEndpointPaths) plus a query-key allowlist. Independent throwaway-copy mutations in /tmp/11.3/repo establish both halves: (a) injecting a request to the unlisted path /api/v3/history?page=1 in RadarrClient.GetMoviesAsync makes the test fail (Failed 1, 'Not found: "/api/v3/history"'), so genuinely unlisted revision/history endpoints are caught and the pin is live/non-vacuous; (b) removing "/api/v3/system/status" from the allowlist keeps the test green, proving the reconciliation reads under test never issue it, and re-adding it while injecting a ProbeAsync system/status request into RadarrMetadataReader.ReadAsync keeps the test green. /api/v3/system/status is only used by RadarrClient/SonarrClient.ProbeAsync (a private SystemStatusPath constant); no caller of ProbeAsync exists in src, and RadarrMetadataReader/SonarrMetadataReader/ArrReadClientFactory never probe. So the entry widens the pin beyond the reconciliation read set. Mitigation that makes this non-material to the acceptance criterion: ADR-018 ('Conditional requests and inventory caching') explicitly records that /system/status, /command, /system/task, and /queue are NOT library revision tokens, so admitting system/status does not let a revision-token or history/since mechanism evade the negative-dependency claim. The only residual is that an injected probe request is not caught, and that the allowlist's XML doc calls the six paths 'the complete set of provider endpoints ArrTags is permitted to call for reconciliation reads' while system/status is a probe endpoint.
evidence: grep: no .ProbeAsync( caller in src; readers/factory do not probe
docs/decisions.md:2310-2312 (ADR-018 research: /system/status is not a library revision token)
/tmp/11.3/repo mutation B: system/status removed from allowlist -> Passed 1, 0 failed
/tmp/11.3/repo mutation C: system/status injected via ProbeAsync with allowlist intact -> Passed 1, 0 failed
findings.recommended_action: Optional cleanup: drop "/api/v3/system/status" from AllowedProviderEndpointPaths so the pin is exactly the negotiation/read set the readers issue (it is only the ProbeAsync path, which the reads do not call), or correct the XML doc to say the pin is the read set plus the probe path. No acceptance criterion depends on this.
